title: Plain Old Blues wins a Chicago Emmy
summary: Hodes did a WTTW show called Plain Old Blues about the beat in the music. It won a Chicago Emmy.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: I went up there and I did a show and I called it Plain Old Blues. That time, I had already recorded Plain Old Blues. Again, I sat down and talked about that it all started with a beat and I made a beat and I says, now the beat appeared "A Closer Walk with.." in spirituals and I played -- it appeared in church, it appeared on the railroad tracks when they were working, it appeared all over. But with the blues appeared everywhere. But always, that beat was there. And if it hasn't that got beat, it hasn't got it.

And I talked and played more, just small remarks. That show got an Emmy, a Chicago Emmy. And there was 13 shows -- 17 shows chosen for a Chicago Emmy and only two from a non-commercial station. "Book Beat" was one and this was the other. So that opened the door for them to do more things and get management to come up with some money.
